findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no soap to be available at the back hand sink. Discussed with PIC, soap was brought to hand sink. Ensure all hand sinks are properly equipped with soap.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed multiple items to be resting within back hand sink. Discussed with PIC, items were removed from hand sinks are. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used to wash hands.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed water bottles to be stored outside of store. Discussed with PIC, bottles will be moved back inside. Ensure water bottles are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to coming apart in the bathroom hand sinks. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop to be resting in mop sink. Discussed with PIC, mop was moved to strainer. Ensure mops are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Observed plastic water bottles being stored right outside facility. Discussed with PIC, water bottles should be stored in a way that prevents outside contamination, limiting exposure to the elements. 

3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

(REPEAT) Observed the back soda machine area (in storage room) to have soda spillage and residue/spray on the walls and floor. Ensure routine cleaning of this area in order to prevent soda debris. Clean the area - wash, rinse, sanitize. This was noted in the General Comments of the routine inspection on 1/10/22, and again on the routine inspection on 3/2/23.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following area in need of repair:
1) Coving damaged in the bag in a box room.
2) Accumulation of trash build up around the soda syrups in the bag in a box room. 
3) The corner of the wall in the bag in a box room damaged. 

Discussed with PIC, ensure facility is maintained in good repair and is being cleaned at a frequency that prevents trash accumulation. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation. 

Observed the major reach-in freezer to have a large amount of ponding, frozen water on the base of the floor. Ice was not touching food-contact surfaces (on the floor only). Repair the freezer so it does not pond water and freeze over. Repair by next routine inspection. This was noted in the General Comments of the last inspection on 1/10/22.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Observed the back soda machine area (in storage room) to have soda spillage and residue/spray on the walls and floor. Ensure routine cleaning of this area in order to prevent soda debris. Clean the area - wash, rinse, sanitize. This was noted in the General Comments of the last routine inspection on 1/10/22.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-307.11: FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301-3-306. 
3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor. 

Cases of bottled water are observed outside of the facility. Cases are in directly sunlight and are not protected from dust/splash/other contamination via weather, environment or passing vehicles. Facility was in compliance after a conversation that took place last week. Per the PIC, corporate came in over the weekend and instructed them to move the bottles back outside. Violation being noted at this time.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

The hand sink next to the 3 part sink next tot eh office in the back of the facility is observed without paper towels at the beginning of the inspection. Paper towels were supplied during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The nozzles of the fountain drink machine are observed with mold/ bacterial growth. PIC is instructed to ensure cleaning often enough to prevent the accumulation of pathogenic growths on the food contact surfaces. The nozzles were cleaned/ sanitized during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
(REPEAT X2) 6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The front of the counter under the soda machines is observed with a long strip missing which exposes the compressed wood underneath. The strip has rough patches to the inspector’s touch.  PIC is instructed to repair the locations so that they are smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

On arrival, the hand sink next to the office is observed blocked with a 24 pack of beer as well as a stack of soda crates. Items were removed and the PIC is instructed to ensure that hand sinks are left accessible at all times by employees.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. 

A bulk package of hot dogs is observed in the walk in cooler open and half empty as well as with the opening unsealed. Package is directly below the fan apparatus for the cooler. PIC is instructed to ensure that the foods are sealed against contamination during storage. Package was moved to a container during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The nozzles of the fountain drink machine are observed with mold/ bacterial growth. PIC is instructed to ensure cleaning often enough to prevent the accumulation of pathogenic growths on the food contact surfaces. The nozzles were cleaned/ sanitized during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 1) The counter next to the hand sink in the front of the building is missing a piece as well as pulling away from itself along the seam. 2) The front of the counter under the soda machines is observed with a long strip missing which exposes the wood underneath. PIC is instructed to repair the locations so that they are smooth and easily cleanable.
6-501.12: (A) (C) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The room with the soda syrup in the dry storage is observed with what appears to be multiple soda explosion on the walls and ceilings. PIC is instructed to clean often enough maintain clean.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-501.114: (P) Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria. The sani bucket next to the hand sink in the front of the building would not register on the inspector's test strips. Sanitizer was remade to correct concentration during the inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 1) The counter next to the hand sink in the front of the building is missing a piece as well as pulling away from itself along the seam. 2) The front of the counter under the soda machines is observed with a long strip missing which exposes the wood underneath. PIC is instructed to repair the locations so that they are smooth and easily cleanable.
6-501.12: (A) (C) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The space between the two stacks of soda syrup in the back of the storage area has what appears to be soda syrup spill that has not been cleaned. The syrup is no longer wet leading the inspector to believe that it has been there a significant amount of time. PIC is instructed to clean spills as soon as they take place.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11  (Pf) The soap dispenser at the sink located adjacent to the 3 part sink in the back is not dispensing soap on the inspector's arrival. The PIC believes the batteries in the dispenser to be out of charge. The batteries were changed during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) The nozzles of the fountain drink machine are soiled. Discussed with the PIC and instructed them to be cleaned and sanitized often enough so as to remain free of soilage. They were removed and cleaned during the inspection.
